The fixtures are synthetic media generated by `tools/generate_video_fixtures.py`.
`manifest.json` records decoded-frame timestamps and exact native packet ends.
`native-timing.json` records FFmpeg 8 packet PTS/duration/position/size in decode
order, plus the Android integer projection `max(0, PTS * 1000000 / timescale)`.
The projection is an oracle for the public extractor convention, not evidence
that an Android device has run the test. `VideoBackendApiTest` verifies actual
imported metadata and decoded tail intervals on Android.

`video-tail-90k.mp4` has no B frames, a leading empty edit, a VFR gap, and a short
final decode sample which is also the largest PTS. PTS 291000 + duration 902 in
1/90000 units rounds once to 3243356us; independent rounding gives 3243355us.
`video-fragmented.mp4` retains B frames and the 20001us CTTS tail in trun data.
`video-tail-cmov.mov` retains the 90k payload and replaces only the final movie
metadata with bounded zlib-compressed cmov metadata.

The shared reader preserves platform PTS cache conventions. Android's native
end uses its existing single edit or leading-empty edit mapping, including the
nearest conversion of movie ticks to media ticks and the zero clamp for
preroll. Stagefright ignores longer edit lists and media rates; this change does
not add general multi-edit/rate playback parity. Non-MOV containers retain the
platform native-duration/fallback contract.

`video-delayed-with-audio-tail.mp4` is a stream-copy combination of the existing
synthetic `video-delayed.mp4` picture and `sound-24fps.mp4` audio, authored by
Motion Studio contributors under the repository MIT license. No external media
is added. Its picture starts at 0.250000s and lasts 1.333333s; audio starts at
0s and lasts 3.008000s. The decoded audio extends beyond the picture interval.
SHA-256: `59468c3249e681f0c66c9e1b120823a5d0ca91ac9cc097fac7fb84e34d7584f3`.

The fixture was generated with FFmpeg
`n8.1.3-16-ge0a878dd70-20261009`, without transcoding:

```sh
ffmpeg -y -t 1.25 -i video-delayed.mp4 -i sound-24fps.mp4 \
  -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c copy -copyts -avoid_negative_ts disabled \
  video-delayed-with-audio-tail.mp4
```

`motion-desktop-media/tests/libav/delayed_import.rs` uses real probing,
transactional import, libav picture decoding, PCM mixing, save/reopen and
undo/redo. It does not inject timestamps or a decoder and does not claim GPU
preview or native-window acceptance.
